### UX & Accessibility (Developer Experience)
**Risk:** Inconsistent error message formatting in `test-schema-upgrade.ts`. Neighboring assertions use block indentation (`\n     `) to format multi-line diagnostic outputs, whereas this error message concatenates skipped objects inline. If multiple objects are skipped on a table, the inline output can wrap awkwardly in CI logs.

**Suggested Fix:**
```typescript
                ? `${absent.length} of ${expected.length} schema.sql objects on ${table} were SKIPPED:\n     `
                  + absent.join('\n     ')
                  + '\n     The boot survived but delta sync would be quietly broken.'
```
